kernelMath.name: kernelMath
kernelMath.scope: Fixed synthetic all-slot kernel mathematics; full returned visit/axis/binding records retained. No path/readout/Chart/FFT/music qualification.

expected.optimizationEquality: exact six-component BigInt objective, no epsilon

readoutMath.name: readoutMath
readoutMath.scope: Complete SC2 finite readout mathematics on fixed literal observations, with full per-call input/output capture; no application materializer/Chart/audio/FFT/music screen or runtime qualification.

bridgeMath.name: bridgeMath
bridgeMath.scope: Fixed mechanism controls; not musical or release qualification.

resources.observationScope: Sampled process memory, not continuous/RSS hard cap or phone measurement; full readouts released by runCase scope, normal GC timing uncontrolled.

scope.workAggregation: Producer source uses max for maximum* fitWork fields and sum for other counters; saved all-call traces are unavailable, so postflight does not independently reconstruct those aggregates.

limitations: Only the fixed original41 observed development cache; no fresh/sealed music.
Five observed clips are five genre proxies, not a ten-genre population.
Inherited B rejection is not an actual C analyzer rejection or end-to-end status parity.
Clock metric uses Analysis.rhythm.beats; B low-support chartBeats can differ from that sequence. Head metric uses uniqueHeads of the one-finger chart.
Local affine source fits, finite exact path, physical onset pool, count retention and identity are separate.
A single bounded Node run does not establish phone performance, perceived musical quality or a full pipeline test.

kernelMath.name: kernelMath
kernelMath.scope: Fixed synthetic all-slot kernel mathematics; full returned visit/axis/binding records retained. No path/readout/Chart/FFT/music qualification.

expected.optimizationEquality: exact six-component BigInt objective, no epsilon

readoutMath.name: readoutMath
readoutMath.scope: Complete SC2 finite readout mathematics on fixed literal observations, with full per-call input/output capture; no application materializer/Chart/audio/FFT/music screen or runtime qualification.

bridgeMath.name: bridgeMath
bridgeMath.scope: Fixed mechanism controls; not musical or release qualification.

resources.observationScope: Sampled process memory, not continuous/RSS hard cap or phone measurement; full readouts released by runCase scope, normal GC timing uncontrolled.

scope.workAggregation: Producer source uses max for maximum* fitWork fields and sum for other counters; saved all-call traces are unavailable, so postflight does not independently reconstruct those aggregates.

limitations: Only the fixed original41 observed development cache; no fresh/sealed music.
Five observed clips are five genre proxies, not a ten-genre population.
Inherited B rejection is not an actual C analyzer rejection or end-to-end status parity.
Clock metric uses Analysis.rhythm.beats; B low-support chartBeats can differ from that sequence. Head metric uses uniqueHeads of the one-finger chart.
Local affine source fits, finite exact path, physical onset pool, count retention and identity are separate.
A single bounded Node run does not establish phone performance, perceived musical quality or a full pipeline test.

sharedScope.headDefinition: uniqueHeads of the one-finger chart, not only measuredOnsetHeads
sharedScope.clockDefinition: Analysis.rhythm.beats; B low-support chartBeats may use a different reference grid
sharedScope.pulseDefinition: uniqueHeads(analysis.pulse?.onsets ?? analysis.onsets); analysis.pulse.onsets is preferred, with analysis.onsets fallback; not a claim every reasonable musical subdivision is labelled
sharedScope.metricFormula: precision=hits/predicted; recall=hits/reference; F1=2*hits/(predicted+reference), with the saved empty-denominator convention
sharedScope.identity20Definition: 20ms measured-onset head identity recall against B, distinct from count ratio
sharedScope.countScope: 144 stored first-return C charts for corrected version; each generated twice, hence 288 actual Chart entries. B uses inherited 144 actual v12 golden certificates.
sharedScope.workScope: Top-level application/Chart/measure entries are explicit runner counts. Internal kernel/path/fit work is producer self-report; maximum fields are per-run aggregated maxima as implemented, not a phone memory bound.
sharedScope.primitiveScope: Cached owner bindings validate source/P-axis/divisibility/lattice/tolerance; no new full8s GCD/OLS recomputation occurred in this result projection.
sharedScope.omittedPrivateData: No media/PCM/raw features/GT/event-note-beat-time arrays or stacks. Hashes, counts, scores, source code and provenance only.

semanticChanges: Accept finite signed original totalEvidence instead of rejecting its negative values

independentCombinedRootReview.scope: Independent fs/hash/raw-count arithmetic and complete negative memberships only; no source/API/fit/path/Chart/FFT/PCM/matcher called. Tiny arithmetic tolerance never changes any producer quality predicate.

causalAudit.scope: Cached causality/accounting of the sole SC2-slot/v2 original41 run; no new candidate/fit/path/Chart/matcher/measure/audio calls.

interpretation.resource: The former five failing IDs completed in this Node attempt. This is not an isolated causal experiment for compaction, a universal bound result, a hard RSS certificate or a phone measurement.
interpretation.slowLayer: Selected slow P can coexist with a fast original preferredPeriod and poor evidence rank because physicalTimingTicks precede every metrical prior. The saved selected path alone cannot prove the score/eligibility of an unrecorded alternative.
interpretation.normalization: Canonical fit invariance is conditional on the same actual assigned physical slot sequence. Real source choices, union grids/role windows and rolling context can differ. Owned2s bindings do not reveal the full8s fit-assignment GCD.
interpretation.chartStage: Exact primary-time membership distinguishes already sparse readout primaries from later Chart omissions; it is not GT matching or a rerun of the selector.
interpretation.oldComparison: No old/new numerical objective equality or optimality comparison is claimed. EC1 versus SC2 changed fitting, loss and state/prior ordering.
